# Fuzz smoke of the CI `fuzz-smoke` job: "<group> <package> <target>", one
# target per line. fuzz-smoke.sh runs each, alone, as
#   go test -run '^$' -fuzz='^<target>$' -fuzztime=10s <package>
# (no unit test runs again here: the unit and race jobs run them).
# A line whose group is "-" is a fuzz test deliberately not in the smoke;
# its seed corpus still runs with the unit and race tests. Every Fuzz
# function of the repository is listed (TestCIWorkflow_FuzzSmokeIsComplete).
1 ./internal/mcp FuzzResolveToolPath
1 ./internal/mcp FuzzResolveToolPath_PhysicalRoot
1 ./internal/search FuzzMatchSymbols
1 ./internal/cache FuzzCacheDecoding
2 ./internal/index FuzzDeclarationIdentity
2 ./internal/index FuzzParentIdentity
2 ./internal/index FuzzIdentityCollision
2 ./internal/languages/golang FuzzExtract
2 ./internal/languages/php FuzzExtractPHP
3 ./internal/languages/typescript FuzzExtractTypeScript
3 ./internal/languages/typescript FuzzModuleSpec
3 ./internal/languages/typescript FuzzTypeArgParser
3 ./internal/languages/terraform FuzzExtractTerraform
- ./internal/mcp FuzzRouteNotificationInvariant
